# My AI Office: who's who

<!-- generated by tools/build_agents.py; edit office/roster.toml instead -->

## Executive Office
Runs the office. The only part that talks to you directly.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Office Manager | `office-manager` | main session | Talks to you and routes every task to the fewest people needed | `route`, `plan-gate`, `approval-gate` |
| Chief of Staff | `chief-of-staff` | now | Knows the state of every open task | `status`, `close-task`, `handoff` |
| Brain Keeper | `brain-keeper` | now | Writes your rules and decisions into the brain, without duplicates | `remember`, `dedupe`, `forget-wrong` |

## HR
Staffs every task. When nobody on the roster fits a task, or part of one, HR extends a role, brings in a contractor or hires.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Talent Scout | `talent-scout` | now | Finds which parts of a task nobody can do, and decides how to cover them | `gap-check`, `staffing-decision` |
| Hiring Manager | `hiring-manager` | now | Creates new permanent employees from the blank form | `job-spec`, `hire`, `edit-role`, `retire` |
| Skill Trainer | `skill-trainer` | now | Writes new skills and gives them to existing roles | `write-skill`, `add-skill` |
| Contractor Desk | `contractor-desk` | now | One-task specialists that leave when the task is done | `hire-contractor`, `end-contract`, `convert-to-hire` |
| Onboarding Officer | `onboarding-officer` | now | Sets new hires up and keeps the roster page true | `onboard`, `roster-sync` |
| Performance Reviewer | `performance-reviewer` | later | Which roles get used, corrected or never called | `role-review`, `overlap-check` |

## Strategy & Ideas
Thinks before anyone builds: new ideas, hard problems, big decisions, risks.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Innovation Lead | `innovation-lead` | now | New ideas and better ways to do things | `brainstorm`, `what-if` |
| Problem Solver | `problem-solver` | now | Breaks a messy problem into options with one recommendation | `options`, `first-principles` |
| Council Moderator | `council-moderator` | now | Runs the 5-advisor council on big decisions | `council` |
| Risk Analyst | `risk-analyst` | now | What could fail, and how to prevent it | `pre-mortem`, `failure-modes` |

## Product & Design
Decides what to build and how it should feel to use.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Product Manager | `product-manager` | now | What users need, and in what order | `requirements`, `user-flows`, `todo-from-handover` |
| UX Designer | `ux-designer` | now | How a flow works for the person using it | `flow-review`, `reduce-steps` |

## Data
Where every record lives, how it's shaped, and getting it back out.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Database Architect | `database-architect` | now | Schema design: tables, keys, versioning, traceability | `schema-design`, `data-adr`, `review-model` |
| Migration Engineer | `migration-engineer` | now | Writes and runs schema changes, always says RUN or NOT RUN | `migration`, `rollback`, `run-status` |
| Data Fetcher | `data-fetcher` | now | Answers questions from the DB with read-only queries | `query`, `export-csv`, `explain-rows` |
| Data Reconciler | `data-reconciler` | now | Finds what's missing or different between Excel, pop files and the DB | `reconcile`, `diff-report` |
| Data Steward | `data-steward` | now | Keeps planned vs actual and traceability true over time | `integrity-audit`, `seal-check` |
| DB Performance Engineer | `db-performance-engineer` | later | Slow queries and slow loads | `profile-query`, `index-advice` |

## Analysis
Turns data into answers: which option is better, what the trend is, and a clear chart.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Statistician | `statistician` | now | Which variation is better, and whether the difference is real | `doe-analysis`, `significance`, `trend` |
| Data Visualizer | `data-visualizer` | later | Charts and dashboards from results | `plot`, `dashboard` |

## Quality
Finds what's broken and proves fixes work. Never reviews its own work.

| Role | Id | Status | One thing | Skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debugger | `debugger` | now | Finds the root cause by tracing at the source | `debug-trace`, `read-traceback` |
| Code Reviewer | `code-reviewer` | now | Reads diffs for bugs and scope creep | `review-diff`, `scope-check` |
| QA Tester | `qa-tester` | now | Runs the real app and checks the change works | `run-app`, `smoke-test` |
| Test Author | `test-author` | now | Writes a regression test for every fix | `write-test`, `fixture` |
| User Simulator | `user-simulator` | now | Walks the app as every kind of user and lists the problems | `grill` |
